reasons: The status badge reads "Bounced", which is not one of the five allowed status words (Sent, Delivered, Delayed, Failed, Not sent). Every time is shown without a time zone, for example "Nov 15, 2026, 2:04 AM". The page also uses "Deliveries" and "Mailable" where the product words are Activity and email/Mailer. The verdict sentence only says to open the delivery, which is the page already open, so it gives no real next step.
